glossary.definition: Electronic Medical Record system used to store patient data
Outpatient Department handling non-emergency patient visits
Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act

references: Ministry of Health Digital Transformation Strategy 2025

in_scope: Patient registration and appointment scheduling module
assumptions: Existing hospital infrastructure supports new system integration
Staff will undergo training before system go-live
constraints: System must comply with MOH data residency requirements
Budget limited to approved fiscal year allocation

risk_analysis.risk: Data migration from legacy system may cause data loss
risk_analysis.mitigation: Full backup before migration and parallel running period

risk_analysis.risk: Staff resistance to new system adoption
risk_analysis.mitigation: Comprehensive training program and change management plan
Engage compliance consultant during development phase

current_process.overview: Patient records managed manually through paper files and disconnected spreadsheets across departments
pain_points: Slow appointment booking process taking up to 20 minutes per patient
Billing errors due to manual data entry
No real-time visibility into bed availability

kpis: Reduce average patient wait time by 40%
goals: Digitize all patient records by Q3 2026
business_drivers.need_for_change: Growing patient volume and regulatory pressure require a unified digital system to replace fragmented manual processes

version_history.changes: Initial draft prepared by Hana Yousef
Updated scope and risk sections after stakeholder review

executive_summary.problem: The hospital currently operates on fragmented manual systems causing inefficiencies in patient care delivery and administrative operations
expected_benefits: Improved patient care quality through unified records access
Full regulatory compliance with MOH standards
executive_summary.proposed_solution: Implement an integrated Hospital Management System covering patient records, scheduling, billing, and staff management
executive_summary.company_description: Regional hospital serving over 500 daily outpatients in the Eastern Province

functional_requirements.description: System shall allow patient registration with unique ID generation
Doctors can view and update patient medical records in real time
System generates itemized billing statements automatically
Appointment reminders sent via SMS 24 hours before scheduled visit
Dashboard showing real-time bed occupancy rates

security: Role-based access control for all system modules
All patient data encrypted at rest using AES-256
performance: System response time under 3 seconds for 95% of requests
Support minimum 200 concurrent users without degradation
availability: System uptime of 99.5% excluding planned maintenance windows
